name: matches the reported neighborhood and group-size examples
input: properties with IDs 1–4 in two neighborhoods

name: minimizes capacity before property count
input: an exact-fill pair and a higher-capacity singleton

name: breaks equal-capacity ties by count then input positions
input: a one-property exact fit and duplicate-capacity alternatives
test:
properties = [
    {'id': 'five-a', 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': 5},
    {'id': 'five-b', 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': 5},
    {'id': 'ten', 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': 10},
]
assert best_capacity_subset(properties, 10, 'north') == ['ten']
properties = [
    {'id': 'later-id', 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': 6},
    {'id': 'earlier-id', 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': 6},
]
assert best_capacity_subset(properties, 6, 'north') == ['later-id']

name: returns an empty list when the target neighborhood cannot fit the group
input: all eligible capacity below the target

name: prefers fewer properties when equal minimum capacity overshoots the target
input: a three-property total of 11 and a two-property total of 11 for a group of 10

name: uses the first input position before capacity order in tied pairs
input: pairs 7+3 and 4+6 both total 10; the earlier pair starts with capacity 7

name: compares later tuple positions when tied pairs share the first property
input: two exact-fill pairs share their first input position and differ in the second

name: compares the third tuple position for tied three-property subsets
input: equal-capacity three-property combinations share their first two input positions

name: uses input positions rather than sorting mixed-type IDs
input: integer and string IDs on otherwise identical eligible properties

name: preserves input order and input data through filtered tie-breaking
input: irrelevant neighborhoods interleaved with tied eligible combinations
test:
from copy import deepcopy
properties = [
    {'id': 'outside-first', 'neighborhood': 'south', 'capacity': 10},
    {'id': 'z-six', 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': 6},
    {'id': 'a-outside', 'neighborhood': 'south', 'capacity': 4},
    {'id': 'y-four', 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': 4},
    {'id': 'b-four', 'neighborhood': 'north', 'capacity': 4},
]
before = deepcopy(properties)
assert best_capacity_subset(properties, 10, "north") == ["z-six", "y-four"]
assert properties == before
assert best_capacity_subset(properties, 10, "north") == ["z-six", "y-four"]
